# `Q-2-19` — Unclosed Editorial Insert

> An editorial-insert span opens with `[++` but no closing `]`
> appears before the end of the block.

## What this means

Quarto markdown supports an editorial-markup family for tracked
changes: `[++inserted text]` for insertions, `[--deleted text]`
for deletions, `[!!highlighted]` for highlights, and
`[>>comment]` for editorial comments. This error fires when the
insert form `[++ ...` is opened but never closed.

## Why this happens

Most often the closing `]` was deleted in an edit, or a literal
`[++` somehow ended up in text without an editorial intent.

## How to fix

Add the closing `]` at the intended end of the inserted text.

If the construct was not intended as editorial markup, escape the
opening bracket: `\[++text]`.

## Example

```markdown
[++
```
